inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read the Mars-Return Cycle in Your Chart
inline.titleEn: 6 Steps to Read Your Mars-Return Chart
inline.titleZh: 解读火星回归星盘的六个步骤
inline.altEn: Six ordered steps for reading a Mars return chart: find natal Mars, identify return date, cast the chart, note the house, read aspects, use as planning prompt
inline.altZh: 解读火星回归星盘的六步骤：定位本命火星、确认回归日期、绘制星盘、注意宫位、解读相位、用作规划提示

items.subEn: Locate the exact degree and sign of Mars in your birth chart
items.subZh: 找到本命星盘中火星的精确度数与星座

items.subEn: Find when transiting Mars next reaches that same degree — your return moment
items.subZh: 查找过境火星何时再次到达该度数，即回归时刻

items.subEn: Cast a chart for that exact date, time, and place as you would a solar return
items.subZh: 以该精确日期、时间和地点绘制星盘，方式同太阳回归

items.subEn: The house holding Mars in the return chart names the life domain for the cycle
items.subZh: 回归星盘中火星所在宫位指明本周期的人生领域

items.subEn: Soft angles ease effort; hard angles flag where friction or conflict is more likely
items.subZh: 柔和相位助力前行；强硬相位预示潜在阻力或冲突

items.subEn: Treat the reading as a two-year planning prompt, then revisit at the next return
items.subZh: 将解读作为未来两年的规划提示，下次回归时回顾验证
